Fire Weather Planning Forecast for Interior Northern California
National Weather Service Sacramento CA
556 AM PST Thu Nov 8 2018

...RED FLAG WARNING FOR INTERIOR NORTHERN CALIFORNIA THROUGH 7 AM
FRIDAY FOR GUSTY NORTH TO EAST WINDS AND LOW HUMIDITY...

.DISCUSSION...
High pressure building inland has resulted in gusty north to east winds
and low humidity over much of northern California.  The
combination of dry fuels, strong wind, and low humidity will lead
to critical fire weather conditions into early Friday. The winds
will decrease during the day on Friday but humidity will remain dry
through the middle of next week.
